unsupported: Nichia America Corporation operates from its headquarters in Wixom, Michigan, serving as the North and South American sales and marketing arm of Nichia Corporation, the Japanese pioneer in LED and laser diode technology.
Established as a wholly owned subsidiary, the company manages regional distribution and technical support for the parent's portfolio of light-emitting diodes, laser diodes, and advanced materials.

The subsidiary does not manufacture products itself; instead, it provides application engineering, sales coordination, and quality assurance liaison for Nichia's LED, laser diode, cathode material, magnetic material, and functional material lines.

Its Detroit-area headquarters houses sales, engineering, and administrative staff, while additional sales offices in Atlanta, Los Angeles, and San Jose cover key automotive, lighting, and display markets.
Automotive programs leverage IATF 16949-certified quality systems for RGB laser diodes and high-reliability LEDs, while UV LED offerings target mercury-free sterilization and curing applications.
The company also supports display backlighting and specialty lighting projects across the Americas.

The operation exists to extend Nichia Corporation's global technology leadership into the Western Hemisphere, offering local inventory, design-in assistance, and compliance with automotive quality standards.
Its differentiation rests on direct access to the parent's R&D pipeline and a field-based engineering team that works alongside OEMs and tier suppliers.
